settings.heading: How will I receive my files?
settings.row_content: Once your payment is confirmed, your download link appears on the order confirmation page and is emailed to the address you used at checkout. Digital products are never shipped.

settings.heading: I didn't get the email. What now?
settings.row_content: Check your spam, promotions and updates folders, and confirm the email address on your order. If you still can't find it, contact us with your order number and we'll resend your download link.

settings.heading: Can I download my files again later?
settings.row_content: Keep your order email so you can return to your download link. If the link has expired or stopped working, contact us with your order number and we'll help.

settings.heading: What format are the files in?
settings.row_content: Most products are PDF files. Some templates include other formats. Each product page lists the format, length and file size under File details.

settings.heading: What do I need to open the files?
settings.row_content: PDF files open in any PDF reader — the built-in viewer on most phones, tablets and computers works. For editable templates, the product page lists which apps are supported.

settings.heading: Can I print the files?
settings.row_content: Yes. Printables and planners are designed for home printing on standard paper sizes. Check the product page for the page size.

settings.heading: Which payment methods do you accept?
settings.row_content: The payment methods available to you are shown at checkout. They can vary depending on your country and on the payment provider active on our store.

settings.heading: Which currency are prices in?
settings.row_content: Prices are shown in Indian Rupees (INR). If your card is in another currency, your bank converts the amount and may charge a conversion fee.

settings.heading: Are taxes included?
settings.row_content: Any applicable taxes are shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.heading: Can I get a refund?
settings.row_content: Because files are delivered instantly, we generally can't accept returns for a change of mind. If a file is faulty, missing, not as described, or you were charged twice, we will fix it, replace it, or refund you. See the Refund and Cancellation Policy.

settings.heading: Can I share or resell what I buy?
settings.row_content: No — your purchase is for your own use unless a product states otherwise. See the License and Usage Policy.

settings.text: We usually reply within one to two working days.
